name: @orbitai/orbitrace
description: Error tracking for Node.js services and browser apps: manual and automatic capture with breadcrumbs

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/browser.js --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2020 --format=esm --outfile=dist/browser.mjs && esbuild src/browser.js --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2020 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/browser.cjs
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm version patch && npm run build && npm publish --access public

author: Orbitai
